names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Михаил (Чельцов), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1930)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Николая , Николая , Михаила пресвитеров и Михаила диакона (1930).»

attestations.note: The day’s eighth entry, a line of four men; THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS, no life page standing behind any of them. The line names four men of two forenames and the four name pages behind it give the surnames the line omits, which is what tells them apart. The line’s grade for this man is «протоиерей» on the name page. A Cyrillic grep for «Чельцов» over every `saint.json` returns `peter-confessor-presbyter-1972` — Пётр Чельцов, another forename and another century — and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page carries no troparion and no kontakion under this name; the three it prints belong to the day’s own feasts and to one of its icons.
